description.value:
All humanoid "puppets" that have succumbed to Mindrot in Vyrm's expeditions should have this adjustment.

  • As all of their minds are connected and reinforced, puppets gain a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects.

  • All puppets have limited telepathy to other nearby puppets. Within 60 feet, they can communicate constantly without being overheard.

    • Note: This is still very limited. Assume they can pass information equivalent to one free casting of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} cantrip per round of combat. It's enough to coordinate, but they don't share all information.

    • Note 2: The Puppets within Vyrm do not count as undead. The minds were erased by the Mindrot, and the original inhabitants are gone, but the bodies themselves count as living.
